agent_explanation: Heavy pair bodies 3 (m~15.7) and 4 (m~10.5) with G~4.12 start ~2.6 apart and fall toward each other, reaching 0.87 at step 8 and 0.41 at step 9 while accelerating to speeds ~7-10. With dt~0.03 (6 substeps) the leapfrog substepping is too coarse to resolve the strongly nonlinear softened gravity at small separation, causing large energy integration error (kinetic ~1248 vs potential ~-1412) and violation at step 9. Reducing dt to 0.001 removes the failure, confirming timestep resolution as cause.
